$description: Smoke Council design tokens (DTCG). The signature surface is a brushed-metal smoke field; near-black chips float on top of it carrying the content, lit by a cyan signal accent, an ember-amber action accent and a seafoam green reserved for the active state. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit here only; the dev server regenerates src/index.css and src/generated/tokens.ts on change.

background.$description: The brushed-metal smoke field. Mid-tone by design so the near-black chips read as floating above it — see the SmokeBackdrop component for the full layered treatment.

foreground.$description: Light text. The smoke field is mid-tone, so type on it is light, not dark.

card.$description: Near-black chip. Cards are dark even in the light theme — that inversion is the system's identity.

primary.$description: Council seafoam green. Reserved for the active tab and live verdicts.

accent.$description: Ember-amber. Floating action button and the selected nav item.

chart1.$description: Signal cyan. Percentages, brackets, sparkline bars, the SEALED outline.

background.$description: Night variant of the smoke field — the metal is dimmed rather than replaced.

primary.$description: Council seafoam green. Reserved for the active tab and live verdicts.

accent.$description: Ember-amber. Floating action button and the selected nav item.

sans.$description: Plain grotesque. Used for the human-readable layer — navigation labels and the Weight badges — in mixed case.

mono.$description: The HUD face. Every instrument label, title and figure is set in this, uppercase and widely tracked.

base.$description: Base corner radius; sm/md/lg/xl derive from this in the theme.
